result.title: Prediction with Expert Advice under Heavy-Tailed Losses
result.summary: We study prediction with expert advice over $T$ rounds with $K$ experts under heavy-tailed losses whose $(1+ε)$-moment is bounded by $θ>0$ for some $ε\in(0,1]$. In this setting, existing algorithms designed for the case $ε=1$ can be suboptimal when $ε<1$, suffering an additional polynomial dependence on $K$. We characterize the minimax pseudo-regret rate as $Θ((θT)^{\frac{1}{1+ε}}(\log K)^{\fracε{1+ε}})$ and establish gap-dependent lower bounds in a self-bounded environment. To attain this minimax rate without prior knowledge of either $ε$ or $θ$, we propose Adaptive Heavy-Tailed FTRL, which uses robust data-dependent scale adaptation together with truncation. We further develop Adaptive Heavy-Tailed OMD, which likewise requires neither $ε$ nor $θ$ and achieves near-optimal regret guarantees in both adversarial and self-bounded environments. Finally, when $ε$ and $θ$ are known, an FTRL algorithm with Shannon-entropy regularization achieves optimal regret guarantees in both environments.

AI.brief_summary: 研究重尾损失（(1+ε) 阶矩有界）下的专家建议预测问题，刻画 minimax 伪遗憾率与自受限环境中的间隙依赖下界，并提出无需已知 ε、θ 的自适应 Heavy-Tailed FTRL/OMD 算法。
AI.relevance_reason: 专家建议聚合与遗憾界可能为 LVR 中多个 latent 假设的动态筛选与计算预算分配提供理论表述工具，其重尾鲁棒性与自适应尺度线索可供核查；但原文不涉及多模态推理，联系属推测。
